cases.name: Netherlands
cases.note: Index case (Dutch man, ~70) died 11 Apr on ship. Wife died 26 Apr Johannesburg. 3rd evacuee in ICU. 8 Dutch nationals in 6-week self-quarantine. Dutch Govt flight landed Eindhoven 10 May.

cases.name: South Africa
cases.note: 2 lab-confirmed at NICD. British national evacuated from Ascension Island; in ICU Johannesburg. Dutch woman died here 26 Apr. Clinical improvement 11 May.

cases.name: Switzerland
cases.note: 1 confirmed after disembarkation. Viral genome published virological.org 8 May: 'ANDV/Switzerland/Hu-3337/2026'. Nextstrain phylogenetics live.

cases.name: France
cases.note: French evacuee PCR positive; symptoms on return flight. In ICU, stable. 5 French nationals hospitalised. 8 flight contacts under investigation.

cases.name: United States
cases.note: 1 American PCR+ in biocontainment at Nebraska Medicine NQU. 1 symptomatic at Emory Atlanta. 16 others in quarantine. CDC Level 3 response. Contacts traced across 8 states.

cases.name: Germany
cases.note: German national (adult female, Case 4) died on board 2 May. PCR-confirmed ANDV per WHO DON600.

cases.name: Tristan da Cunha
cases.note: 1 suspected case. British Army paratroopers + medics parachuted onto island 10 May via RAF. Oxygen and equipment air-dropped.

cases.name: Spain

cases.name: United Kingdom
cases.note: 20 British nationals at Arrowe Park for 72-hr assessment (11 May). 45-day home isolation follows. 2 British nationals confirmed positive abroad.

news.title: 18 US passengers repatriated; 1 PCR+ in biocontainment at Nebraska NQU, 1 symptomatic at Emory Atlanta, 16 in quarantine unit
US contacts dispersed across 8 states: Texas, Virginia, Arizona, California, New Jersey, Maryland under self-monitoring in addition to Nebraska and Georgia
MV Hondius departs Tenerife for Netherlands with remaining crew. 23-country evacuation complete
French evacuee confirmed PCR positive for Andes virus; ICU stable. 5 French passengers to remain hospitalised
British Army paratroopers and medics successfully jump onto Tristan da Cunha to treat suspected hantavirus patient
South African British national in Johannesburg 'clinically improving but still ill' — SA Health Ministry
Tedros to CNN: 'Incubation 6–8 weeks — we expect more cases. This is not another COVID.' Public risk remains low
All passengers evacuated from MV Hondius. Last group departed Tenerife delayed by strong winds
CDC Level 3 response activated. Epidemiologists deployed to Canary Islands for exposure risk assessment
Dutch charter flight (Eindhoven) carries 26 passengers: 8 Dutch + 18 from India, Germany, Argentina, Belgium, Greece, Portugal, Ukraine
Italy places 4 under 42-day active surveillance: contacts dispersed to Tuscany, Calabria, Campania and Veneto following KLM flight exposure at Rome Fiumicino
DON600: 8 cases (6 confirmed ANDV, 2 suspected), 3 deaths. CFR 38%. Human-to-human transmission confirmed
Viral sequence published: 'ANDV/Switzerland/Hu-3337/2026'. Nextstrain phylogenetic tree now live
WHO confirms causative agent as Andes virus (ANDV) — only hantavirus with documented person-to-person transmission
KLM notified: Dutch woman briefly boarded KL592 Johannesburg before death. Passengers being contacted
WHO first notified by UK IHR focal point of severe respiratory cluster aboard Dutch-flagged cruise ship
First death on board: Dutch male passenger (index case) — suspected ANDV from land activities in Patagonia

travel.name: Argentina
travel.summary: Endemic Andes virus region and source of the 2026 MV Hondius outbreak. 101 endemic ANDV cases since June 2025. Patagonia is the highest-risk zone globally.
travel.rec: Avoid all non-essential travel to Patagonia. If travelling: strict rodent avoidance, no camping in endemic areas, seek immediate care if fever + respiratory symptoms develop within 6 weeks.

travel.name: Chile
travel.summary: Co-endemic ANDV region. Index case spent extended time in Chile. Southern lake district carries identical risk to Argentine Patagonia.
travel.rec: Avoid rural and forested areas of southern Chile. Urban Santiago and northern Chile carry lower risk. Trekkers and campers in the south: extreme caution.

travel.name: Netherlands
travel.summary: 3 confirmed cases (imported). Dutch nationals in 6-week self-quarantine. No local transmission identified.
travel.rec: General travel safe. Risk confined to MV Hondius passengers. No community spread.

travel.name: Germany
travel.summary: 1 confirmed case (died at sea). Contacts traced and monitored. No ongoing local transmission.
travel.rec: General travel safe. No risk to general public.

travel.name: France
travel.summary: 1 confirmed case in ICU. 5 French passengers hospitalised. 8 flight contacts under investigation.
travel.rec: General travel safe. Risk limited to MV Hondius passengers. No community transmission evidence.

travel.name: United States
travel.summary: 1 confirmed case in biocontainment (Nebraska). 1 symptomatic at Emory. 16 in quarantine. Contacts traced across 8 states. CDC Level 3 response active.
travel.rec: General travel safe. ANDV risk limited to quarantined contacts. Sin Nombre virus (separate strain) endemic in US Southwest — avoid rodent contact in rural areas.

travel.name: South Africa
travel.summary: 2 lab-confirmed cases at NICD Johannesburg. One patient deceased. British national clinically improving. 62 local contacts traced.
travel.rec: General travel safe. Cases are imported and isolated. No endemic HPS risk in South Africa.

travel.name: Switzerland
travel.summary: 1 confirmed case, home quarantine. Viral genome sequenced and published.
travel.rec: General travel safe. Case is isolated. No ongoing transmission risk.

travel.name: Spain
travel.summary: 1 suspected case under investigation. Spanish nationals quarantined in Madrid military hospital.
travel.rec: General travel safe. Canary Islands carry no local ANDV risk. Monitor Spanish health authority updates.

travel.name: United Kingdom
travel.summary: Monitoring status. 20+ passengers in 72-hr assessment. 2 British nationals confirmed positive abroad.
travel.rec: General travel safe. Rural UK has Puumala virus (bank voles) — very mild, different strain.

travel.name: Canada
travel.summary: 4 Canadians under 21-day self-isolation. No confirmed cases.
travel.rec: General travel safe. Rural prairie areas carry standard Sin Nombre risk. Current ANDV risk limited to monitored evacuees.

travel.name: Australia
travel.summary: Passengers in quarantine. No confirmed cases.
travel.rec: General travel safe. Australia has no known endemic hantavirus.

travel.name: Singapore
travel.summary: 2 residents at NCID, both PCR negative. Under 30-day quarantine.
travel.rec: General travel safe. No endemic hantavirus in Singapore.

travel.name: New Zealand
travel.summary: Passengers self-monitoring. No confirmed cases.
travel.rec: General travel safe. No endemic hantavirus in New Zealand.

travel.name: Denmark
travel.summary: IHR focal point notified. Nationals self-monitoring. Puumala virus endemic.
travel.rec: General travel safe. Rural/forested areas have vole-related PUUV risk — mild disease, different from ANDV.

travel.name: Sweden
travel.summary: Nationals on 42-day monitoring. Sweden has high Puumala virus rates — entirely separate from ANDV.
travel.rec: General travel safe. PUUV risk in northern forests: mild kidney disease, rarely fatal.

travel.name: Italy
travel.summary: 4 contacts under 42-day active surveillance following KLM flight exposure at Rome Fiumicino. Contacts in Tuscany, Calabria, Campania, and Veneto. All asymptomatic.
travel.rec: General travel safe. No community transmission. Risk limited to identified KLM flight contacts already under surveillance by regional health units.

travel.name: Japan
travel.summary: 1 Japanese national at UK hospital — asymptomatic, repatriated.
travel.rec: General travel safe. Seoul virus background risk is very low CFR.

travel.name: Philippines
travel.summary: 38 Filipino crew under monitoring. None confirmed ill.
travel.rec: General travel safe. No endemic HPS in Philippines.

travel.name: India
travel.summary: Nationals returned via Dutch evacuation flight. Under self-monitoring.
travel.rec: General travel safe. No significant endemic hantavirus burden.

travel.name: Belgium
travel.summary: Nationals on Dutch evacuation flight. Puumala virus present.
travel.rec: General travel safe. PUUV in rural Belgium is separate from ANDV and rarely serious.

travel.name: Greece
travel.summary: Nationals on Dutch evacuation flight. Dobrava virus (DOBV) present.
travel.rec: General travel safe. DOBV in rural Greece is a low-level concern.

travel.name: Portugal
travel.summary: Nationals on Dutch evacuation flight. Home monitoring.
travel.rec: General travel safe. Risk limited to monitored evacuees.

travel.name: Ukraine
travel.summary: Nationals on Dutch evacuation flight. Dobrava/Puumala viruses present.
travel.rec: General travel safe with standard conflict-zone advisories.

travel.name: Brazil
travel.summary: No MV Hondius connection. Endemic HPS (Araraquara, Juquitiba strains) in SE states — ~40% CFR, separate from current outbreak.
travel.rec: Caution in rural São Paulo, Minas Gerais, Paraná. Urban travel is safe.

travel.name: Bolivia
travel.summary: Laguna Negra hantavirus endemic in Santa Cruz and lowland areas.
travel.rec: Avoid rural lowland areas. Highland cities are low risk.

travel.name: Paraguay
travel.summary: Laguna Negra virus endemic in Chaco and eastern regions.
travel.rec: Avoid rural areas. Urban Asunción is low risk.

travel.name: Panama
travel.summary: Choclo virus endemic in Azuero Peninsula — mild HPS, low CFR.
travel.rec: Standard precautions in rural Azuero. Panama City is low risk.

travel.name: Norway
travel.summary: No current connection. Puumala virus endemic — mild disease.
travel.rec: General travel safe. Rural/forest areas have vole-related PUUV risk.

travel.name: Finland
travel.summary: High Puumala virus rates — mild nephropathia epidemica, no current outbreak connection.
travel.rec: General travel safe. Forested rural areas have PUUV vole risk.

travel.name: Russia
travel.summary: Hantaan and Puumala endemic in Siberia and Ural regions. No current connection.
travel.rec: Standard precautions in rural Siberian farming areas.

travel.name: China
travel.summary: World's highest HFRS burden (Hantaan/Seoul viruses) — kidney-focused disease, no current outbreak connection.
travel.rec: Caution in rural farming regions. Cities and tourist sites are generally safe.

travel.name: Mexico
travel.summary: Sin Nombre variants present in northern border states. No current outbreak connection.
travel.rec: General travel safe. Standard rodent-avoidance in northern states.

travel.name: Peru
travel.summary: Limited surveillance. Some Andes-adjacent strains possible in southern regions.
travel.rec: General travel safe. Machu Picchu and highlands are low risk.

travel.name: South Korea
travel.summary: Hantaan virus historically endemic near DMZ. No current connection.
travel.rec: General travel safe. Seoul and tourist areas are low risk.
